01 Introduction
Gives an introduction to the tables, including information on copyright and disclaimer.

02 Components
Gives an overview of all components, listing INFOODS tagnames, descriptions, recommended units, maximal decimal places and significant digits, in English and French.
Offre un aperçu de tous les composants, avec leurs identifiants INFOODS, descriptions, unités recommandées, nombre maximal de décimales et chiffres significatifs.

Condensed food composition table without statistics: Presents compiled component values per 100 g EP for all foods for 39 components – without statistics or documentation for data taken from outside Africa.

05 NV_sum_57 (per 100 g EP)

Full food composition table without statistics: Presents compiled component values per 100 g EP for all foods and 57 components – without statistics or documentation for data taken from outside Africa.

06 NV_stat_57 (per 100 g EP)
Full food composition table with statistics: Presents compiled component values per 100 g EP for all foods and 57 components– with statistics and documentation for data taken from outside Africa.

07 Yield factors, sing_ing
Yield factors used in single ingredient cooked foods, including source(s) for each food.
Facteurs de rendement utilisés pour les aliments cuits à un seul ingrédient, avec les sources pour chaque aliment.
08 Retention factors
Retention factors used in calculating single ingredient cooked foods and mixed dishes in English and French.

09 Mixed dishes
Recipes of mixed dishes, including recipe description and yield factors, in English and French.

10 FoodEx2 codes
List of food names, food codes and the corresponding FoodEx2 code.

Comparaison des noms et des codes d´aliments des éditions 2012 et 2019 de la TCAAO.

components.method_en: Edible portion coefficient (from as purchased to as described)
Edible portion coefficient (from as described to as eaten)

Sum of proximate components (g/100 g EP) = water (g/100 g EP) + total fat (g/100 g EP) + available carbohydrate (g/100 g EP) + total protein (g/100 g EP) + ash (g/100 g EP) + total dietary fibre (g/100 g EP) + alcohol (g/100 g EP)
Energy (kJ/100 g EP) = total protein (g/100 g EP) × 17 + total fat (g/100 g EP) × 37 + available carbohydrate (g/100 g EP) × 17 + total dietary fibre (g/100 g EP) × 8 + alcohol (g/100 g EP) × 29
Energy (kcal/100 g EP) = total protein (g/100 g EP) × 4 + total fat (g/100 g EP) × 9 + available carbohydrate (g/100 g EP) × 4 + total dietary fibre (g/100 g EP) × 2 + alcohol (g/100 g EP) × 7
Total protein (g/100 g EP) = nitrogen conversion factor (XN) × total nitrogen (g/100 g EP)

components.name_en: Fat, total or [fat, derived by analysis using continuous extraction]
components.name_fr: Lipides totaux ou [lipides dérivés d’une analyse par extraction continue]
components.method_en: Mixed solvent extraction or [Soxhlet method with continuous extraction]
Carbohydrate, available; calculated by difference (g/100 g EP) = 100 – (water + total fat + total protein + ash + total dietary fibre + alcohol) (g/100 g EP)
Vitamin A in retinol equivalents (mcg/100 g EP) = retinol (mcg/100 g EP) + beta-carotene equivalents (mcg/100 g EP) / 6

components.name_en: Vitamin A (expressed in retinol activity equivalents)
components.name_fr: Vitamine A (exprimée en équivalent activité rétinol)
components.method_en: Vitamin A in retinol activity equivalents (mcg/100 g EP) = retinol (mcg/100 g EP) + beta-carotene equivalents (mcg/100 g EP) / 12
Beta-carotene equivalents (mcg/100 g EP) = beta-carotene (mcg/100 g EP) + alpha-carotene (mcg/100 g EP) / 2 + beta-cryptoxanthin (mcg/100 g EP) / 2 or [HPLC]
Vitamin D = Vitamin D2 + Vitamin D3; analysed by HPLC

components.name_en: Vitamin E (expressed in alpha-tocopherol equivalents) or [alpha-tocopherol]
components.name_fr: Vitamine E (exprimée en équivalent alphatocophérol) ou [alphatocophérol]
components.method_en: Vitamin E expressed in alpha-tocopherol equivalents (mg/100 g EP) = alpha-tocopherol (mg/100 g EP) + 0.4 × beta-tocopherol (mg/100 g EP) + 0.1 × gamma-tocopherol (mg/100 g EP) + 0.01 × delta-tocotrienol (mg/100 g EP) or [HPLC]
Niacin equivalents (mg/100 g EP) = niacin (mg/100 g EP) + tryptophan (mg/100 g EP) / 60 or [HPLC, microbiological]

components.name_en: Folate, total or [folate, sum of vitamers] (vitamin B9)
components.name_fr: Folate, total ou [somme des vitamères] (vitamine B9)

components.method_en: Dietary folate equivalents (mcg/100 g EP) = naturally occurring food folates (mcg/100 g EP) + 1.7 × synthetic folic acid (mcg/100 g EP)
Various methods (see User Guide section 5 Components)

components.name_fr: Facteur de conversion de acides gras
components.method_en: From literature sources (see User Guide section 5 Components)
Fatty acids, total saturated (g/100 g EP) = fatty acids, total saturated (% of total FA) × fatty acid conversion factor × fat, total (g/100 g EP) / 100
Fatty acids, total monounsaturated (g/100 g EP) = fatty acids, total monounsaturated (% of total FA) × fatty acid conversion factor × fat, total (g/100 g EP) / 100
Fatty acids, total polyunsaturated (g/100 g EP) = fatty acids, total polyunsaturated (% of total FA) × fatty acid conversion factor × fat, total (g/100 g EP) / 100
Linoleic acid (g/100 g EP) = linoleic acid (% of polyunsaturated FA) × fatty acids, total polyunsaturated (g/100 g EP) / 100
Alpha-linolenic acid (g/100 g EP) = alpha-linolenic acid (% of polyunsaturated FA) × fatty acids, total polyunsaturated (g/100 g EP) / 100
